integrity: Analytical asymptotic proof using exact covariance, Jensen counting, dominated convergence; finite numerical checks are corroborating rather than complete proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integer m and fixed kappa>0; explicit proper complex Gaussian finite-difference-plus-common-factor family only; expected count and one-point angular density only, no point-process limit, no uniform parameter regime. Historical priority remains open to equivalent implicit formulations.
title: Hybrid atomic–continuous spectral zeros: a new fractional boundary law
